objective: Close Wave 3 A2: MacCapabilityDetector must expose deterministic architecture, memory, pressure, thermal, power, network, and Foundation Models facts for routing without false positives.

criteria.promise: MacCapabilitySnapshot represents 8/16/32/64 GB Apple silicon and Intel profiles, thermal state, memory pressure, low power, battery, network, and Foundation Models availability explicitly.
Routing policy consumes machine facts deterministically: small/pressured/low-power Macs prefer small local routes, critical pressure/thermal penalizes local, and networkUnavailable excludes cloud.
Focused tests cover the matrix with simulated snapshots only; runtime probes that cannot be read remain nil/unknown rather than positive claims.

verification_gates.expected: All required facts are represented with optional unknowns where appropriate.
Routing decisions react deterministically to simulated machine facts.

verification_gates.procedure: Run swift test --filter MacCapabilityDetectorTests and swift test --filter ModelRoutingTests plus git diff --check on scoped files.
verification_gates.expected: Tests pass without depending on the actual MacBook state.

recon_evidence: MacCapabilityDetector, MacCapabilityDetectorTests, ModelRouting, and ModelRoutingTests were inspected. Runtime Foundation Models and machine state are tested through injected/simulated snapshots, not the lead Mac's current state.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Machine capability/routing matrix from current tests and any focused additions.
